scope: Offline-only real-tensor feasibility study. It cannot modify serving output or authorize a lossy production path.
authorization: Execution reads only the fixed round-253 review receipt and candidate-3 freeze paths. The receipt supplies the exact reviewed commit and a hard drand floor >=6357227; neither is caller-selectable. Python runs isolated with site processing disabled. The scorer, test, plan, launcher, drand verifier, Python, Node, complete NumPy tree, numpy.libs/OpenBLAS tree, and complete @noble verifier dependency tree must match the reviewed freeze before use and remain generation-identical through completion. BLAS and numerical thread counts are fixed at one.
randomness: After both reviewers authorize candidate 2, obtain the same round from api.drand.sh, api2.drand.sh, and api3.drand.sh. Preserve all three responses in one receipt, require exact agreement, then BLS-verify the agreed record.
input_binding: Open every capture artifact and the randomness receipt once with O_NOFOLLOW, hash and consume the same descriptor/mmap, retain descriptor identity through scoring, then require unchanged dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime, pathname identity, and final digest before publication.

split.rule: Domain-separated SHA-256 ranks split keys 4096/4096 and query positions 64/64 per layer. Correction parameters use calibration keys only. Metrics use held-out queries and only selected held-out key IDs. The exact reviewed commit, not a caller input, is mixed into the seed.

quantizer.scale: For each block, run deterministic Lloyd scale/code refinement from every positive E2M1 mapping of amax plus scale 1.0, retain the lowest raw F32 SSE, and include amax/6 exactly among the starts.
quantizer.interpretation: This is a strong continuous-scale feasibility candidate, not a proven lower bound on query-weighted error. It is guaranteed by test not to regress amax/6 or the round-251 [4.1,3.0] representative scale.

rotation: One seeded orthonormal 512-wide Walsh-Hadamard transform with seeded sign flips per layer, applied identically to keys and queries.
correction: Per-layer, per-channel alpha=sum(reference*quantized)/sum(quantized^2), fitted on calibration keys only and applied after rotated E2M1 quantization.
metric: sqrt(sum((q dot (candidate_k-reference_k))^2) / sum((q dot reference_k)^2)) over every held-out query head and every valid selected held-out key; accumulate numerator and denominator in F64.
acceptance_formula: PASS iff all integrity/shape/finiteness/split/layer checks pass and at least one candidate has held-out query-weighted relative RMSE <=0.05. If integrity fails, verdict FAIL. If valid candidates all exceed 0.05, verdict NO_RESULT—not a proof that every FP4 scale optimizer fails—and stop this branch before kernel work.
post_pass_rule: PASS only authorizes an exact packed-format implementation followed by the fixed 100-case paired NLL/top-1 gate and owner review of every nonzero fidelity delta.
evidence: Exclusive fsync'd manifest/raw/summary publication followed by terminal receipt. The verifier opens and retains every artifact descriptor together, validates schemas, recomputes raw-row coverage, aggregates, winner, threshold and verdict, then verifies all generations and the exact final path set before success. Cross-artifact timed mutation tests are mandatory.
resource_bound: CPU/Numpy only; memory-map the 276.8 MB capture through held descriptors, process one layer/candidate at a time, require ds4-server/ds4/fio idle, and never start the GLM engine.
